suites.title: Core properties: time sealing, observation contract, workspace and plan saving, monitoring policy, audit, HTTP views

groups.name: [1] no semantic output may see the future

checks.name: read_record, snapshot and inspect at day N equal a record ending at N
planning context at day N equals a record ending at N

groups.name: [2] one observation contract, with units, provenance and coverage

checks.name: 28 observations all carry the eight contract fields
every numeric evidence item has a non-empty unit and provenance
every observation window is JSON-serialisable and well-formed
status and sufficiency never disagree
a whole snapshot serialises without a custom encoder

groups.name: [3] missing data is insufficient, never normal

checks.name: a six-day-old record returns insufficient somewhere, not all-normal
no domain of a thin record is called within_baseline off no data
a domain with no records in the window is insufficient, not summarised

groups.name: [4] period comparison uses exactly the requested windows

checks.name: the main observation covers exactly the requested window
its counts are computed over that window, not cumulatively
the comparison names the requested reference window
and computes the reference over that window too
swapping the two windows swaps the comparison

groups.name: [5] the Agent plans; deterministic code supplies facts, never a verdict

checks.name: planning context is decision-ready and contains no generated schedule
planning context includes raw-stream movement and wear coverage
planning context names what the record cannot know
a logged injury is said, not enforced
no plan validator remains: nothing in code judges the Agent's plan
a well-formed final answer with no workspace change is accepted as written
the final answer carries no plan: a plan lives in the workspace draft
a resting heart rate position reads correctly at the ends and below the middle
weeks meeting the WHO floor is a count of weeks, not a share
the last injury and a joint's last injury keep their own dates

groups.name: [6] the simulation clock seals the future

checks.name: a semantic tool refuses data after the simulation date
the high-frequency tool also refuses the simulated future
read_record in a review clamps a later end to the signal date
the review event reports the effective bound as_of and the requested one
a normal turn still refuses a future date rather than clamping
an intraday review cannot read sensor samples after the event time
an active simulation cannot move backwards without a reset
monitor replay never advances beyond the simulation clock

groups.name: [7] enforced in code, not asked of the model

checks.name: a tool in the catalogue is allowed
Bash is denied
Read is denied
WebFetch is denied
exec is denied
rm_rf is denied
get_coaching_snapshot is denied
mcp__coach__read_record is denied
the removed plan validator is not a tool the gate allows
any Codex request other than a coach tool call is declined
a tool call outside the catalogue returns a failed result, not a run
the model is offered exactly the coach tools
Codex's own context blocks, bundled skills, agents and extra tools are switched off
the shell reads the skills folder and writes only the workspace, with named denials
without a workspace the shell writes nothing
there is no conversation-level latch that could lock planning by mistake
memory survives a new session, staged for the agent to read
remembered prompt injection cannot expand tool permission
the system specification treats the memory file as untrusted data
the system specification treats retrieved text as data, not authority
an entry carries all six fields the brief names
the log round-trips
a non-mutating recommendation needs no pretend approval

groups.name: [8] the signal light: reproducible detection; the coach decides each Alert

checks.name: layer one runs over every participant without raising
a sustained condition is passed on once, on the day it starts
no signal is phrased as a prediction
every signal reproduces from the record truncated to its day
time simulation stops on or after its start at a real signal day
what is due reproduces from history ending on that day
a condition already holding when the run starts is due at once, as new
and it carries when it began and how it looked then
a reviewed condition waits for the day the coach chose, then comes back
and with no day chosen it stays on the page without coming back
every one-off event is due when it happens, even the day after another
time simulation at the dataset end, with everything reviewed, reports nothing due
a daily aggregate is available only at the explicit end-of-day boundary
all seven detectors expose one chart contract with thresholds and units
monitor charts are sealed at their requested simulation date
every chart marker comes from the same detector that raises the signal
an intraday chart stops at the exact simulated event boundary
raw Fitbit streams are indexed and combined without a daily-only proxy
persistence counts consecutive prior days, bounded by the record
the facts the coach weighs are severity, days running and coverage, and no decision
no notification policy remains in code

groups.name: [9] absolute standards and threshold provenance

checks.name: an under-active person is measured against WHO, not themselves
that shows up as below_guideline in the snapshot
under-activity reaches the Agent as decision context, not a code-made plan
every threshold declares a source and an evidence class
the registry holds every branching number, honestly classed
device wear and both ACWR windows are honestly labelled project heuristics
every intraday detector branch value is registered
monitor and realtime branch on the registry, not shadow constants
the low-step cutoff declares itself a proxy for rest, not proof
the remaining monitor branch values are registered honest heuristics
the whole monitor reads the registry

groups.name: [10] the reachable surface is small, and bound to one person

checks.name: the agent exposes the record read, the sensor window, guideline search and the review
two read the record, one searches guidelines, one is control; memory and plans are files
no tool accepts a participant identifier
two agents for two people expose the same tools
but each answers only from the person it was built for
the read-only tools require no participant argument and no time is faked
skills are instruction files only: nothing in them runs, and the old ASKABLE path is gone

groups.name: [11] the HTTP surface serves the new views (offline)

checks.name: the participant list covers all sixteen
profile state seals the future and reports WHO adequacy
the snapshot view carries top findings and a data-quality read
the inspect view returns a period and its comparison
the server no longer exposes a skills route
the retired deterministic plan generator is gone
ordinary planning has no approval endpoint or approval controls
the time bar owns the background simulator, and the page says an Alert is not a diagnosis
the Monitor tab exposes a real metric timeline rather than text cards only
the monitoring replay plays back every recorded review with what the coach was handed and read
the planning skill makes the Agent the planner, with no validator to satisfy
skills install as Codex-format folders with their shared references
the rules for asking the person are written into the skills that need them, not left to a read
the system prompt carries the rules of every turn, not each task's procedure
wide tables scroll inside their container, not the page
the overflow is not masked with body overflow-x hidden
each participant is offered by what it shows, not by an id and a count
the clock date input can shrink inside the narrow-viewport grid

groups.name: [12] richer data: reconciliation, device evidence, overview, codes

checks.name: a self-report and its overlapping Fitbit entry merge to one session
the merged session carries the device evidence, not a second count
a distinct same-day session survives instead of being discarded
a device-only session keeps its own provenance
training inspection exposes device heart rate, steps and calories
physiology inspection exposes daily heart-rate-zone minutes
the physiology domain is in the snapshot with device evidence
recovery overview considers strain beyond readiness and resting HR
lifestyle overview considers intake beyond weight
the overview validates missing, text-placeholder and out-of-range values
a missing max heart rate is a warning, not a value
a valid max heart rate is stored as context
overview quality warnings surface in the data-quality observation
participant metadata never becomes a plan constraint
soreness-area SNOMED codes are preserved as raw codes, not a count
and inspection surfaces the codes with an unmapped-code limitation
coverage is domain-specific: training density is below any-record density
an inspect observation reports its own domain's coverage

groups.name: [13] one read returns the whole record, against the window before

checks.name: one call returns every domain over the window and the one just before
coverage counts each domain's own recorded days
changes are this window minus the previous one, computed in code
the state at the window's end carries the planning facts, not the full injury list
a load ratio over too light a month is withheld everywhere the coach reads it, with the reason
where the record starts there is no previous window to compare, not an invented one

groups.name: [14] the transcript is public, and the workspace is checked

checks.name: tool calls become public events
Codex reasoning is dropped at the boundary, never kept
an assistant draft is kept for the audit, not turned into a transcript event
a shell command is kept with its result for the stream and the audit
the trace shows a command as written, without the login shell or the per-turn directory
an apply_patch file change is kept with its paths for the stream and the audit
any other Codex item is flagged as outside the coach tools
Codex compacting a long conversation is its own bookkeeping, not a refused tool
a tool result becomes a summarised event tied to its tool
a record read is summarised by its windows and findings, not raw JSON
a shell command is shown as the agent wrote it, unescaped from Codex's wrapper
workflow states derive from which tool ran
opening the planning skill is reading a skill; only writing the draft is drafting the plan
reading or editing the workspace reads as using the workspace
semantic reads during a bound review read as investigating
a public assistant message reads as responding
audit source lists semantic reads; memory and draft changes stay in the action trace
the turn stages the workspace into the agent's working folder
a draft written in an answer is committed, reported and shown as a table
a draft commits nothing on its own: the turn records no human decision
a revision is committed and its table marks what changed
a draft written while still asking is undone and returned for correction
a draft the page cannot show is returned with what to fix
a memory entry that quotes the person is committed and logged
an entry quoting words the person never said fails the turn and is never committed
a new entry must carry today's simulation date
a monitoring turn cannot change memory: it is restored and the agent told
a file outside the workspace layout is removed, not committed
a failed turn commits nothing to the workspace
memory and plans become citable context cards
the prompt names the workspace cards by file rather than repeating their content
only saving makes a draft the plan: version 1, draft cleared
a saved version is read-only: a change is restored and reported
a draft whose first day has passed is stale and cannot be saved
saving a stale draft is refused
a draft is compared only with the saved days it would replace
a conversation at an earlier date sees only memory written by then
committing that conversation keeps the later entries on disk
the audit log with workspace entries still verifies
the retired approval vocabulary is no longer a legal decision

groups.name: [15] monitoring audit, structured review, the coach's Alert decision

checks.name: a review without observations and limitations is rejected
an unknown verdict is rejected by the handler, not just the schema
an empty note is rejected by the handler
a string where a list of observations belongs is rejected
a review without a yes-or-no Alert decision and its reason is rejected
a grounded review records verdict, note, observations, limitations and the decision
the monitoring prompt gives facts to weigh, not cut-offs, and forbids causal claims
a monitoring audit row persists the verdict and the notification action
scanned days accumulate in the run
an exact retry of the same advance changes nothing
a contiguous advance adds only the new days to the same run
an Alert is kept in the run with what it was about, for the next review
a discontinuous start begins a new run with nothing raised
a start before the run also begins a new run
reset clears the run
each monitoring review appends exactly one audit row
the row carries the Agent verdict and the final notification action
the coach's decision is the Alert decision, recorded as given
the facts the coach weighed travel with its decision
the next review is told which Alerts the run has already raised
a repeat is weighed on the level at the last Alert of its kind beside the level now
the facts reach the coach in the prompt, a condition with when it began
a condition's second review carries the coach's first one
the day the coach chose to look again is kept, and a later 'not again' clears it
the review's observations and limitations reach the result
the JSONL row persists the full structured review
the JSONL row persists the decision with the run it belongs to
a missing review persists a truthful non-empty fallback
and the unreviewed signal is shown, not hidden, marked as code's fallback
a legacy row without the structured fields still verifies
the browser advance returns and persists the run
retrying the identical HTTP advance does not inflate the run
the signals view reports the same run
a contiguous advance accumulates scanned days in the same run
a discontinuous start over HTTP begins a new run
saving with no draft is refused
the plan view shows the draft, against no saved plan yet
saving makes the draft version 1 and clears it
the profile shows the saved plan as the active plan
discarding removes the draft; both decisions are their own audit entries
a draft whose days have started cannot be saved
only save and discard are decisions
the memory view reads the workspace memory up to the date
a new chat forgets the conversation but keeps memory, plans and the run
only the workspace can be kept
Reset clears the run over HTTP
Reset clears the workspace: memory, draft and saved plans

groups.name: [16] skipped - pass --live for one real conversation

checks.name: an edited earlier audit entry breaks the hash chain

a suite that stops on an assertion is reported as a failure

a Pi account store readable by others is ignored
each participant gets their own thread in their own directory
after a restart the conversation, its messages and its clock come back
the next message resumes that same Codex thread
only the last turn keeps its trail, with timed steps, for a reload
a restored conversation still refuses to move time backwards
a conversation the next message cannot resume does not hold the clock
a changed tool catalogue starts a new thread and clears the stale transcript
the page gets a participant's conversation back after a restart
a conversation the next turn cannot resume is not shown as remembered
Reset forgets only that participant's conversation
state directories are created with their parents on first write
the reply language follows the latest message, decided in code
path-like participant ids are refused before touching files

suites.title: Behaviour contracts: exact audit records, failed runs, statistics wording

groups.name: checks

checks.name: 15 calendar days are distinct from 7 report records
no baseline claim without a comparison
descriptive data does not certify explanatory sufficiency
device-only duration is attributed to device
event density is not wearable or self-report completeness
no recorded sessions does not establish no exercise
comparison preserves reference sample and calendar counts
numeric evaluator accepts label-first and number-first answers
numeric evaluator rejects swapped counts and contradictory coverage
tool failures carry the error flag
exact tool parameters and untruncated results survive audit
public call IDs, exact prompt and terminal metadata survive audit
model drafts stay in the audit; only the checked final answer is the reply
failed terminal state is audited and cleared
a truncated model stream cannot be recorded as success
a plan draft is held to the activity and intensity vocabulary the page shows
planning context retains load units and readiness sample window
uncomputed readiness trend is not called flat
planning context does not certify normal recovery by default
read_record takes only an optional window length and end, each described

suites.title: Computed statistics, self-report wording, and the data fixes: young-record load, device sessions, repeated nights, WHO coverage

groups.name: checks

checks.name: HTTP parameter returns exact coverage, deltas, units and recorded-sleep balance
HTTP headline states the direction of sleep shortfall explicitly
missing evidence is not a zero-valued comparison; overlapping dates are explicit
statistics are always computed by the tool; there is no option to skip them
a low soreness score is a sorer day and a high fatigue score a fresher one, as the data show
an answer left at the end of its scale for weeks is not read as a rating; a single one is
recovery history reaches the coach in words, with no scale to interpret
a young record averages its load over the weeks it covers, not over four
a device-detected session carries no invented load
a night repeated in the export is counted once
activity against WHO reports the coverage of the activity minutes it uses

suites.title: Asking before planning: a question waits for the person, no plan rides on it, warning symptoms stop

groups.name: checks

checks.name: no context tool or gate: the catalogue and the instructions ask the coach to find out, in its own words
HTTP/SSE: a turn that asks waits for the person and a draft written with the question is undone; the answer after it writes the draft the page shows
reading historical memory does not mutate the active conversation clock
a monitoring note cannot change the plan draft
a warning symptom ends the turn as a recorded safety stop, with no plan and no lock

suites.title: Checked final answers: citations from this turn, corrections, missing records

groups.name: checks

checks.name: an invented citation returns to the same session and the corrected answer is shown
raw drafts stay audit-only; the page shows only the checked final answer
cited sources are listed in citation order, linkable by their full ID
invented, stale and guidance-only citations, unknown outcomes, missing reasons and extra fields are returned
an answer that reads no records needs no citation
removing records leaves no recovery answers to read, rather than normal recovery

suites.title: Delivery over HTTP/SSE: tables from tools, drafts kept in the audit, the plan draft table

groups.name: checks

checks.name: reset is rejected while the same participant has a running turn
HTTP/SSE shows exact tool values in tables and the checked final answer as the reply
model drafts are audit-only, not streamed to the UI
the plan draft table comes from the workspace change and marks what changed; no change means no displayed schedule

the shell can read the skills and their references
it cannot read raw records, code, the project or login files
it can write its workspace: memory and the plan draft
it cannot write saved plans, the skills, the rest of its folder or the project
the network probe is installed and executable inside the sandbox
it has no network
